The lateral surface is smooth and wraps around the sides, connecting the edges of the two bases. The cylinder has a uniform cross-section along its height, maintaining the same diameter throughout. 

To make a successful grip, ensure your fingers wrap around the curved surface, applying even pressure to maintain control and stability.
